notable_residents.name: Janis Joplin
notable_residents.detail: The source says the dates are documented on Joplin's driver's licence, and separately records competing claims for 112 Lyon Street and 635 Ashbury Street. The apartment number the source gives is omitted here under the site's privacy rules.

permits.description: raise the outer top rail on the back stairs to 36 inches above the treads

narrative.lead: Five apartments over three storeys on the block of Lyon facing the Panhandle. A published guide to notable residences places Janis Joplin here from June 1967 to April 1968 and says the dates come from her driver's licence — the most specific of the three competing Joplin addresses it lists.

sections.heading: Permit history
sections.body: Three permits, 2000–2023: two roofs and a stair rail. Nothing is recorded before 2000.

sections.heading: Three addresses, one tenancy
sections.body: The guide that places Joplin here also lists 112 Lyon Street, five doors down, as an alternative for the same period, and 635 Ashbury Street as a further Joplin address. Only the claim on this page carries a stated basis — the driver's licence — and none of the three has been traced here to a primary record. The pages do not adjudicate between them.
